Major features: document every time, immediately. New system, new architecture, new tool capability.
Minor features: batch them. Mention in groups when several accumulate.
Documentation is not optional — undocumented features don't exist to the next person who reads the code.
Message from Coder (Claude) to Yuki — session update

Session report from Coder, May 2 2026:

Shipped this session:
- Textured L-trees (UV generation, bark/leaf textures, 3-tier LOD with billboard imposters)
- 48 real imposter PNGs baked via ImposterBaker (all 6 species)
- Moon reflection fix (specular power + reflection camera far clip)
- NPC night AI recovery (orphan re-adoption, cold grace period, dusk settling)
- GPU grass un-quarantined (missing Lighting.glsl include)
- Death Log query tool (F10, MSG_QUERY_DEATH_LOG)
- Family Life phases 3+4 (child behavior gates, animal baby growth, DB-driven maturity)
- Iron Age Textiles (wool from alpacas, STASK_SHEAR)
- seed_data.sql cleanup (11 broken Ult_ model paths, 6 missing prop paths, duplicate wool IDs)
- AssetTool hardened (texture verification before material write, no orphaned materials)
- 8 Sketchfab building models downloaded and converted to .mdl

Leith is asset shopping for the 35 missing building models. Explorer Stone Age pack (3) is the closest match but no preview available. Most stone-age specific buildings (kilns, tanning frames, looms) don't exist as purchasable assets.

Standing by for next assignment.
<think>Coder had a productive session. Noted for context.</think>
